newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MBf says may raise stake in Sri Hartamas.
newsitem.headline: MBf says may raise stake in Sri Hartamas.

text.p: Malaysia's MBf Holdings Bhd said on Thursday it may double its stake in property developer Sri Hartamas Corp Bhd to 20 percent.

MBf Holdings president and chief executive officer Loy Hean Heong was quoted by the national Bernama news agency as saying the move would enable MBf Holdings to get a greater contribution from Sri Hartamas' bottom line.
Loy is also chairman of Sri Hartamas.
MBf Holdings decided to take up a stake in Sri Hartamas because of its landbank of more than 263 hectares located in choice areas of Kuala Lumpur, Port Dickson and Johor Baru, he told reporters.
Loy said only about 12 hectares of Sri Hartamas' total landbank had been developed, adding that they would be fully developed over 10 years.
